site/src/data/forecast-examples/prospect-2026-07-07.ts:336:        "text": "Framing and exact resolver: this targets the BLS Producer Price Index for final demand, seasonally adjusted, month-over-month percent change for June 2026, resolved on the first official print in the Producer Price Index news release. The variant is the headline final demand SA monthly percent change, not NSA 12-month change, not core, and not final demand goods or services."
site/src/data/forecast-examples/prospect-2026-07-07.ts:351:        "call": "BLS current PPI news release headline and recent monthly total final demand values",
site/src/data/forecast-examples/prospect-2026-07-07.ts:352:        "result": "BLS May 2026 release says final demand rose 1.1 percent in May, 1.1 percent in April, and 0.7 percent in March; the unadjusted 12-month change was 6.5 percent for May."
site/src/data/forecast-examples/prospect-2026-07-07.ts:357:        "call": "BLS Table A reference class for total final demand monthly percent changes",
site/src/data/forecast-examples/prospect-2026-07-07.ts:358:        "result": "Fetched total final demand monthly changes: 2025 May 0.3, Jun 0.2, Jul 0.8, Aug -0.2, Sep 0.6, Oct 0.1, Nov 0.4, Dec 0.4, 2026 Jan 0.6, Feb 0.5, Mar 0.7, Apr 1.1, May 1.1."
site/src/data/forecast-examples/prospect-2026-07-07.ts:363:        "call": "BLS Table A component context for May 2026 final demand",
site/src/data/forecast-examples/prospect-2026-07-07.ts:364:        "result": "Fetched May 2026 components: final demand goods 2.8 percent, final demand foods 0.6 percent, final demand energy 10.7 percent, final demand goods less foods and energy 0.8 percent, final demand services 0.3 percent, final demand less foods, energy, and trade services 0.8 percent."
site/src/data/forecast-examples/prospect-2026-07-07.ts:370:        "result": "BLS item metadata includes group FD item 4 as Final demand; BLS series metadata file was current through 2026 M05, consistent with the latest May 2026 release."
site/src/data/forecast-examples/prospect-2026-07-07.ts:378:        "text": "Prior/update/interval: model is a 13-month historical base-rate plus two-month persistence prior. Historical sample is BLS Table A May 2025-May 2026 total final demand values [0.3, 0.2, 0.8, -0.2, 0.6, 0.1, 0.4, 0.4, 0.6, 0.5, 0.7, 1.1, 1.1], mean = 0.51 and sample sigma = 0.37. Adjustment components: +0.20 for April-May persistence and broad goods/core firmness, -0.05 for expected partial energy/gasoline mean reversion, +0.04 for services/core carry-through, giving 0.70. 80% interval method: values themselves are the change-series dispersion, so 80% half-width is roughly 1.28*sigma = 1.28*0.37 = 0.47, rounded to 0.5; final implied bounds are 0.7 - 0.5 = 0.2 and 0.7 + 0.5 = 1.2."
site/src/data/forecast-examples/prospect-2026-07-07.ts:382:        "text": "Counter-consideration: upside risk is another large June energy or gasoline pass-through plus firm portfolio-management and transportation services, which would land above the interval if headline final demand prints above 1.2 percent. Downside risk is a sharp reversal in gasoline, crude, or trade-service margins, which would land below the interval if headline final demand prints below 0.2 percent."
